text: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

title: I Peter 2:1
text: ¶Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

title: I Peter 2:2
text: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

title: I Peter 2:3
text: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord [is] gracious.

title: I Peter 2:4
text: ¶To whom coming, [as unto] a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, [and] precious,

title: I Peter 2:5
text: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ. {are: or, be ye}

title: I Peter 2:6
text: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

title: I Peter 2:7
text: Unto you therefore which believe [he is] precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner, {precious: or, an honour}

title: I Peter 2:8
text: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, [even to them] which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

title: I Peter 2:9
text: But ye [are] a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light: {peculiar: or, purchased} {praises: or, virtues}

title: I Peter 2:10
text: Which in time past [were] not a people, but [are] now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

title: I Peter 2:11
text: Dearly beloved, I beseech [you] as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

title: I Peter 2:12
text: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by [your] good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation. {whereas: or, wherein}

title: I Peter 2:13
text: ¶ Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

title: I Peter 2:14
text: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

title: I Peter 2:15
text: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

title: I Peter 2:16
text: As free, and not using [your] liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God. {using: Gr. having}

title: I Peter 2:17
text: Honour all [men]. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king. {Honour all: or, Esteem all}

title: I Peter 2:18
text: Servants, [be] subject to [your] masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

title: I Peter 2:19
text: For this [is] thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully. {thankworthy: or, thank}

title: I Peter 2:20
text: For what glory [is it], if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer [for it], ye take it patiently, this [is] acceptable with God. {acceptable: or, thank}

title: I Peter 2:21
text: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: {for us: some read, for you}

title: I Peter 2:22
text: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

title: I Peter 2:23
text: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed [himself] to him that judgeth righteously: {himself: or, his cause}

title: I Peter 2:24
text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed. {on: or, to}

title: I Peter 2:25
text: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

title: I Peter 3:1
text: ¶Likewise, ye wives, [be] in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

title: I Peter 3:2
text: While they behold your chaste conversation [coupled] with fear.

title: I Peter 3:3
text: Whose adorning let it not be that outward [adorning] of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

title: I Peter 3:4
text: But [let it be] the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, [even the ornament] of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

title: I Peter 3:5
text: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

title: I Peter 3:6
text: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement. {daughters: Gr. children}

title: I Peter 3:7
text: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with [them] according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

title: I Peter 3:8
text: ¶Finally, [be ye] all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, [be] pitiful, [be] courteous: {love as: or, loving to the}

title: I Peter 3:9
text: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

title: I Peter 3:10
text: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

title: I Peter 3:11
text: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

title: I Peter 3:12
text: For the eyes of the Lord [are] over the righteous, and his ears [are open] unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord [is] against them that do evil. {against: Gr. upon}

title: I Peter 3:13
text: And who [is] he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

title: I Peter 3:14
text: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy [are ye]: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

title: I Peter 3:15
text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and [be] ready always to [give] an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear: {fear: or, reverence}

title: I Peter 3:16
text: ¶Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

title: I Peter 3:17
text: For [it is] better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

title: I Peter 3:18
text: ¶For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

title: I Peter 3:19
text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

title: I Peter 3:20
text: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

title: I Peter 3:21
text: ¶The like figure whereunto [even] baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

title: I Peter 3:22
text: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

title: I Peter 4:1
text: ¶Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

title: I Peter 4:2
text: That he no longer should live the rest of [his] time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

title: I Peter 4:3
text: For the time past of [our] life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

title: I Peter 4:4
text: ¶Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with [them] to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of [you]:

title: I Peter 4:5
text: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

title: I Peter 4:6
text: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

title: I Peter 4:7
text: ¶But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

title: I Peter 4:8
text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins. {shall: or, will}

title: I Peter 4:9
text: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

title: I Peter 4:10
text: As every man hath received the gift, [even so] minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

title: I Peter 4:11
text: If any man speak, [let him speak] as the oracles of God; if any man minister, [let him do it] as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 4:12
text: ¶Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

title: I Peter 4:13
text: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

title: I Peter 4:14
text: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy [are ye]; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

title: I Peter 4:15
text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or [as] a thief, or [as] an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

title: I Peter 4:16
text: Yet if [any man suffer] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

title: I Peter 4:17
text: For the time [is come] that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if [it] first [begin] at us, what shall the end [be] of them that obey not the gospel of God?

title: I Peter 4:18
text: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

title: I Peter 4:19
text: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls [to him] in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

title: I Peter 5:1
text: ¶The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

title: I Peter 5:2
text: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight [thereof], not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind; {which...: or, as much as in you is}

title: I Peter 5:3
text: Neither as being lords over [God's] heritage, but being ensamples to the flock. {being lords over: or, overruling}

title: I Peter 5:4
text: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

title: I Peter 5:5
text: ¶Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all [of you] be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

title: I Peter 5:6
text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

title: I Peter 5:7
text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

title: I Peter 5:8
text: ¶Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

title: I Peter 5:9
text: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

title: I Peter 5:10
text: ¶But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle [you].

title: I Peter 5:11
text: To him [be] glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 5:12
text: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

title: I Peter 5:13
text: The [church that is] at Babylon, elected together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Marcus my son.

title: I Peter 5:14
text: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace [be] with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

title: II Peter 1:1
text: ¶Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ: {Simon: or, Symeon} {God...: Gr. of our God and Saviour}

title: II Peter 1:2
text: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

title: II Peter 1:3
text: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that [pertain] unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue: {to: or, by}

title: II Peter 1:4
text: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

title: II Peter 1:5
text: ¶And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

title: II Peter 1:6
text: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

title: II Peter 1:7
text: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

title: II Peter 1:8
text: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make [you that ye shall] neither [be] barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. {barren: Gr. idle}

title: II Peter 1:9
text: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

title: II Peter 1:10
text: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

title: II Peter 1:11
text: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:12
text: ¶Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know [them], and be established in the present truth.

title: II Peter 1:13
text: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting [you] in remembrance;

title: II Peter 1:14
text: Knowing that shortly I must put off [this] my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

title: II Peter 1:15
text: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

title: II Peter 1:16
text: ¶For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

title: II Peter 1:17
text: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

title: II Peter 1:18
text: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

title: II Peter 1:19
text: ¶We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

title: II Peter 1:20
text: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

title: II Peter 1:21
text: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake [as they were] moved by the Holy Ghost. {in old time: or, at any time}

title: II Peter 2:1
text: ¶But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

title: II Peter 2:2
text: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of. {pernicious ways: or, lascivious ways, as some copies read}

title: II Peter 2:3
text: ¶And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

title: II Peter 2:4
text: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast [them] down to hell, and delivered [them] into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

title: II Peter 2:5
text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth [person], a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

title: II Peter 2:6
text: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned [them] with an overthrow, making [them] an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

title: II Peter 2:7
text: ¶And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

title: II Peter 2:8
text: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed [his] righteous soul from day to day with [their] unlawful deeds;)

title: II Peter 2:9
text: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

title: II Peter 2:10
text: ¶But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous [are they], selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities. {government: or, dominion}

title: II Peter 2:11
text: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord. {them: some read, themselves}

title: II Peter 2:12
text: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

title: II Peter 2:13
text: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, [as] they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots [they are] and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

title: II Peter 2:14
text: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children: {adultery: Gr. an adulteress}

title: II Peter 2:15
text: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam [the son] of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

title: II Peter 2:16
text: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

title: II Peter 2:17
text: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

title: II Peter 2:18
text: For when they speak great swelling [words] of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, [through much] wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error. {clean: or, for a little, or, a while, as some read}

title: II Peter 2:19
text: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

title: II Peter 2:20
text: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

title: II Peter 2:21
text: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known [it], to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

title: II Peter 2:22
text: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog [is] turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

title: II Peter 3:1
text: ¶This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in [both] which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

title: II Peter 3:2
text: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

title: II Peter 3:3
text: ¶Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

title: II Peter 3:4
text: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as [they were] from the beginning of the creation.

title: II Peter 3:5
text: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water: {standing: Gr. consisting}

title: II Peter 3:6
text: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

title: II Peter 3:7
text: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

title: II Peter 3:8
text: ¶But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day [is] with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

title: II Peter 3:9
text: ¶The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

title: II Peter 3:10
text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

title: II Peter 3:11
text: ¶[Seeing] then [that] all these things shall be dissolved, what manner [of persons] ought ye to be in [all] holy conversation and godliness,

title: II Peter 3:12
text: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat? {hasting...: or, hasting the coming}

title: II Peter 3:13
text: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

title: II Peter 3:14
text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

title: II Peter 3:15
text: And account [that] the longsuffering of our Lord [is] salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

title: II Peter 3:16
text: As also in all [his] epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as [they do] also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

title: II Peter 3:17
text: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know [these things] before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

title: II Peter 3:18
text: But grow in grace, and [in] the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him [be] glory both now and for ever. Amen.

title: I John 1:1
text: ¶That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

title: I John 1:2
text: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen [it], and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

title: I John 1:3
text: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship [is] with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

title: I John 1:4
text: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

title: I John 1:5
text: ¶This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

title: I John 1:6
text: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

title: I John 1:7
text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

title: I John 1:8
text: ¶If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

title: I John 1:9
text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us [our] sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

title: I John 1:10
text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

title: I John 2:1
text: ¶My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

title: I John 2:2
text: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for [the sins of] the whole world.

title: I John 2:3
text: ¶And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

title: I John 2:4
text: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

title: I John 2:5
text: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

title: I John 2:6
text: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

title: I John 2:7
text: ¶Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

title: I John 2:8
text: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

title: I John 2:9
text: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

title: I John 2:10
text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him. {occasion...: Gr. scandal}

title: I John 2:11
text: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

title: I John 2:12
text: ¶I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

title: I John 2:13
text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

title: I John 2:14
text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

title: I John 2:15
text: Love not the world, neither the things [that are] in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

title: I John 2:16
text: For all that [is] in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

title: I John 2:17
text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

title: I John 2:18
text: ¶Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

title: I John 2:19
text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would [no doubt] have continued with us: but [they went out], that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

title: I John 2:20
text: ¶But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

title: I John 2:21
text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

title: I John 2:22
text: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

title: I John 2:23
text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [(but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also].

title: I John 2:24
text: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

title: I John 2:25
text: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, [even] eternal life.

title: I John 2:26
text: These [things] have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

title: I John 2:27
text: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him. {in him: or, in it}

title: I John 2:28
text: ¶And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

title: I John 2:29
text: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him. {ye know that every: or, know ye etc.}

title: I John 3:1
text: ¶Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

title: I John 3:2
text: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

title: I John 3:3
text: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

title: I John 3:4
text: ¶Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

title: I John 3:5
text: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

title: I John 3:6
text: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

title: I John 3:7
text: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

title: I John 3:8
text: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

title: I John 3:9
text: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God. {is born: or, has been born}

title: I John 3:10
text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

title: I John 3:11
text: ¶For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another. {message: or, commandment}

title: I John 3:12
text: Not as Cain, [who] was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

title: I John 3:13
text: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

title: I John 3:14
text: ¶We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not [his] brother abideth in death.

title: I John 3:15
text: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

title: I John 3:16
text: Hereby perceive we the love [of God], because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down [our] lives for the brethren.

title: I John 3:17
text: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels [of compassion] from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

title: I John 3:18
text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

title: I John 3:19
text: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him. {assure: Gr. persuade}

title: I John 3:20
text: ¶For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

title: I John 3:21
text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, [then] have we confidence toward God.

title: I John 3:22
text: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

title: I John 3:23
text: ¶And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

title: I John 3:24
text: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

title: I John 4:1
text: ¶Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

title: I John 4:2
text: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

title: I John 4:3
text: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that [spirit] of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

title: I John 4:4
text: ¶Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

title: I John 4:5
text: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

title: I John 4:6
text: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

title: I John 4:7
text: ¶Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

title: I John 4:8
text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

title: I John 4:9
text: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

title: I John 4:10
text: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son [to be] the propitiation for our sins.

title: I John 4:11
text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

title: I John 4:12
text: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

title: I John 4:13
text: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

title: I John 4:14
text: ¶And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son [to be] the Saviour of the world.

title: I John 4:15
text: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

title: I John 4:16
text: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

title: I John 4:17
text: ¶Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world. {our love: Gr. love with us}

title: I John 4:18
text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

title: I John 4:19
text: We love him, because he first loved us.

title: I John 4:20
text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

title: I John 4:21
text: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

title: I John 5:1
text: ¶Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

title: I John 5:2
text: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

title: I John 5:3
text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

title: I John 5:4
text: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, [even] our faith.

title: I John 5:5
text: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

title: I John 5:6
text: ¶This is he that came by water and blood, [even] Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

title: I John 5:7
text: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

title: I John 5:8
text: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

title: I John 5:9
text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

title: I John 5:10
text: ¶He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

title: I John 5:11
text: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

title: I John 5:12
text: He that hath the Son hath life; [and] he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

title: I John 5:13
text: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

title: I John 5:14
text: ¶And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us: {in: or, concerning}

title: I John 5:15
text: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

title: I John 5:16
text: If any man see his brother sin a sin [which is] not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

title: I John 5:17
text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

title: I John 5:18
text: ¶We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

title: I John 5:19
text: [And] we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

title: I John 5:20
text: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

title: I John 5:21
text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

title: II John 1:1
text: ¶The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

title: II John 1:2
text: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

title: II John 1:3
text: Grace be with you, mercy, [and] peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love. {be: Gr. shall be}

title: II John 1:4
text: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

title: II John 1:5
text: ¶And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

title: II John 1:6
text: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

title: II John 1:7
text: ¶For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

title: II John 1:8
text: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward. {wrought: or, gained, some copies read, ye have gained, but that ye, etc.}

title: II John 1:9
text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

title: II John 1:10
text: ¶If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into [your] house, neither bid him God speed:

title: II John 1:11
text: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

title: II John 1:12
text: ¶Having many things to write unto you, I would not [write] with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full. {face to...: Gr. mouth to mouth} {our: or, your}

title: II John 1:13
text: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

title: III John 1:1
text: ¶The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth. {in...: or, truly}

title: III John 1:2
text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth. {wish: or, pray}

title: III John 1:3
text: ¶For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

title: III John 1:4
text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

title: III John 1:5
text: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

title: III John 1:6
text: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well: {after...: Gr. worthy of God}

title: III John 1:7
text: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

title: III John 1:8
text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth. {fellowhelpers: or, joint-labourers}

title: III John 1:9
text: ¶I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

title: III John 1:10
text: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth [them] out of the church.

title: III John 1:11
text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

title: III John 1:12
text: ¶Demetrius hath good report of all [men], and of the truth itself: yea, and we [also] bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

title: III John 1:13
text: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

title: III John 1:14
text: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] to thee. [Our] friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name. {face to...: Gr. mouth to mouth}

title: Jude 1:1
text: ¶Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, [and] called:

title: Jude 1:2
text: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

title: Jude 1:3
text: ¶Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort [you] that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

title: Jude 1:4
text: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Jude 1:5
text: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

title: Jude 1:6
text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day. {first estate: or, principality}

title: Jude 1:7
text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire. {strange: Gr. other}

title: Jude 1:8
text: ¶Likewise also these [filthy] dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

title: Jude 1:9
text: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

title: Jude 1:10
text: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

title: Jude 1:11
text: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

title: Jude 1:12
text: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds [they are] without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

title: Jude 1:13
text: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

title: Jude 1:14
text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

title: Jude 1:15
text: ¶To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard [speeches] which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

title: Jude 1:16
text: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling [words], having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

title: Jude 1:17
text: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: Jude 1:18
text: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

title: Jude 1:19
text: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

title: Jude 1:20
text: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

title: Jude 1:21
text: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

title: Jude 1:22
text: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

title: Jude 1:23
text: And others save with fear, pulling [them] out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

title: Jude 1:24
text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present [you] faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

title: Jude 1:25
text: To the only wise God our Saviour, [be] glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:1
text: ¶The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified [it] by his angel unto his servant John:

title: Revelation of John 1:2
text: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

title: Revelation of John 1:3
text: ¶Blessed [is] he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time [is] at hand.

title: Revelation of John 1:4
text: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace [be] unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

title: Revelation of John 1:5
text: And from Jesus Christ, [who is] the faithful witness, [and] the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

title: Revelation of John 1:6
text: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him [be] glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:7
text: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they [also] which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:8
text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 1:9
text: ¶I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

title: Revelation of John 1:10
text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

title: Revelation of John 1:11
text: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send [it] unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

title: Revelation of John 1:12
text: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;

title: Revelation of John 1:13
text: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks [one] like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

title: Revelation of John 1:14
text: His head and [his] hairs [were] white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes [were] as a flame of fire;

title: Revelation of John 1:15
text: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

title: Revelation of John 1:16
text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance [was] as the sun shineth in his strength.

title: Revelation of John 1:17
text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

title: Revelation of John 1:18
text: I [am] he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

title: Revelation of John 1:19
text: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

title: Revelation of John 1:20
text: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

title: Revelation of John 2:1
text: ¶Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

title: Revelation of John 2:2
text: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

title: Revelation of John 2:3
text: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

title: Revelation of John 2:4
text: Nevertheless I have [somewhat] against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

title: Revelation of John 2:5
text: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:6
text: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:7
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

title: Revelation of John 2:8
text: ¶And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

title: Revelation of John 2:9
text: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and [I know] the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but [are] the synagogue of Satan.

title: Revelation of John 2:10
text: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast [some] of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

title: Revelation of John 2:11
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

title: Revelation of John 2:12
text: ¶And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

title: Revelation of John 2:13
text: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, [even] where Satan's seat [is]: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas [was] my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

title: Revelation of John 2:14
text: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

title: Revelation of John 2:15
text: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:16
text: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 2:17
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth [it].

title: Revelation of John 2:18
text: ¶And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet [are] like fine brass;

title: Revelation of John 2:19
text: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last [to be] more than the first.

title: Revelation of John 2:20
text: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

title: Revelation of John 2:21
text: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

title: Revelation of John 2:22
text: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

title: Revelation of John 2:23
text: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

title: Revelation of John 2:24
text: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

title: Revelation of John 2:25
text: But that which ye have [already] hold fast till I come.

title: Revelation of John 2:26
text: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

title: Revelation of John 2:27
text: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

title: Revelation of John 2:28
text: And I will give him the morning star.

title: Revelation of John 2:29
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:1
text: ¶And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

title: Revelation of John 3:2
text: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

title: Revelation of John 3:3
text: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

title: Revelation of John 3:4
text: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 3:5
text: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

title: Revelation of John 3:6
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:7
text: ¶And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

title: Revelation of John 3:8
text: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

title: Revelation of John 3:9
text: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

title: Revelation of John 3:10
text: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 3:11
text: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

title: Revelation of John 3:12
text: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, [which is] new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and [I will write upon him] my new name.

title: Revelation of John 3:13
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:14
text: ¶And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God; {of the Laodiceans: or, in Laodicea}

title: Revelation of John 3:15
text: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

title: Revelation of John 3:16
text: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

title: Revelation of John 3:17
text: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

title: Revelation of John 3:18
text: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and [that] the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

title: Revelation of John 3:19
text: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

title: Revelation of John 3:20
text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

title: Revelation of John 3:21
text: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

title: Revelation of John 3:22
text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

title: Revelation of John 4:1
text: ¶After this I looked, and, behold, a door [was] opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard [was] as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

title: Revelation of John 4:2
text: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and [one] sat on the throne.

title: Revelation of John 4:3
text: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and [there was] a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

title: Revelation of John 4:4
text: And round about the throne [were] four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

title: Revelation of John 4:5
text: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and [there were] seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

title: Revelation of John 4:6
text: And before the throne [there was] a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, [were] four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

title: Revelation of John 4:7
text: And the first beast [was] like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast [was] like a flying eagle.

title: Revelation of John 4:8
text: ¶And the four beasts had each of them six wings about [him]; and [they were] full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come. {rest...: Gr. have no rest}

title: Revelation of John 4:9
text: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

title: Revelation of John 4:10
text: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

title: Revelation of John 4:11
text: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

title: Revelation of John 5:1
text: ¶And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

title: Revelation of John 5:2
text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

title: Revelation of John 5:3
text: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

title: Revelation of John 5:4
text: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

title: Revelation of John 5:5
text: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

title: Revelation of John 5:6
text: ¶And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:7
text: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

title: Revelation of John 5:8
text: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four [and] twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints. {odours: or, incense}

title: Revelation of John 5:9
text: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

title: Revelation of John 5:10
text: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:11
text: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

title: Revelation of John 5:12
text: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

title: Revelation of John 5:13
text: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, [be] unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 5:14
text: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four [and] twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 6:1
text: ¶And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

title: Revelation of John 6:2
text: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

title: Revelation of John 6:3
text: ¶And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

title: Revelation of John 6:4
text: And there went out another horse [that was] red: and [power] was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

title: Revelation of John 6:5
text: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 6:6
text: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and [see] thou hurt not the oil and the wine. {A measure: the word choenix signifieth a measure containing one wine quart, and the twelfth part of a quart}

title: Revelation of John 6:7
text: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

title: Revelation of John 6:8
text: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth. {unto them: or, to him}

title: Revelation of John 6:9
text: ¶And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

title: Revelation of John 6:10
text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

title: Revelation of John 6:11
text: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they [were], should be fulfilled.

title: Revelation of John 6:12
text: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

title: Revelation of John 6:13
text: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind. {untimely figs: or, green figs}

title: Revelation of John 6:14
text: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

title: Revelation of John 6:15
text: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

title: Revelation of John 6:16
text: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

title: Revelation of John 6:17
text: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

title: Revelation of John 7:1
text: ¶And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

title: Revelation of John 7:2
text: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

title: Revelation of John 7:3
text: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 7:4
text: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: [and there were] sealed an hundred [and] forty [and] four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

title: Revelation of John 7:5
text: Of the tribe of Juda [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad [were] sealed twelve thousand.

title: Revelation of John 7:6
text: Of the tribe of Aser [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses [were] sealed twelve thousand.

title: Revelation of John 7:7
text: Of the tribe of Simeon [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar [were] sealed twelve thousand.

title: Revelation of John 7:8
text: Of the tribe of Zabulon [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin [were] sealed twelve thousand.

title: Revelation of John 7:9
text: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

title: Revelation of John 7:10
text: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:11
text: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and [about] the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

title: Revelation of John 7:12
text: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, [be] unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 7:13
text: ¶And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

title: Revelation of John 7:14
text: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:15
text: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

title: Revelation of John 7:16
text: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

title: Revelation of John 7:17
text: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

title: Revelation of John 8:1
text: ¶And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

title: Revelation of John 8:2
text: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

title: Revelation of John 8:3
text: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer [it] with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne. {offer...: or, add it to the prayers}

title: Revelation of John 8:4
text: And the smoke of the incense, [which came] with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.

title: Revelation of John 8:5
text: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast [it] into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake. {into: or, upon}

title: Revelation of John 8:6
text: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

title: Revelation of John 8:7
text: ¶ The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

title: Revelation of John 8:8
text: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

title: Revelation of John 8:9
text: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

title: Revelation of John 8:10
text: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

title: Revelation of John 8:11
text: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 8:12
text: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

title: Revelation of John 8:13
text: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

title: Revelation of John 9:1
text: ¶And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:2
text: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:3
text: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

title: Revelation of John 9:4
text: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 9:5
text: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment [was] as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

title: Revelation of John 9:6
text: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

title: Revelation of John 9:7
text: And the shapes of the locusts [were] like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads [were] as it were crowns like gold, and their faces [were] as the faces of men.

title: Revelation of John 9:8
text: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as [the teeth] of lions.

title: Revelation of John 9:9
text: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings [was] as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

title: Revelation of John 9:10
text: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power [was] to hurt men five months.

title: Revelation of John 9:11
text: And they had a king over them, [which is] the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue [is] Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath [his] name Apollyon. {Apollyon: that is to say, A destroyer}

title: Revelation of John 9:12
text: One woe is past; [and], behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

title: Revelation of John 9:13
text: ¶And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

title: Revelation of John 9:14
text: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

title: Revelation of John 9:15
text: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men. {for an hour: or, at an hour}

title: Revelation of John 9:16
text: And the number of the army of the horsemen [were] two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

title: Revelation of John 9:17
text: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses [were] as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

title: Revelation of John 9:18
text: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

title: Revelation of John 9:19
text: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails [were] like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

title: Revelation of John 9:20
text: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

title: Revelation of John 9:21
text: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

title: Revelation of John 10:1
text: ¶And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow [was] upon his head, and his face [was] as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

title: Revelation of John 10:2
